title: Map2Vid: Embodied Navigation Video Generation with Human-Friendly Motion Control
title_zh: Map2Vid：具备人性化运动控制的具身导航视频生成

paragraphs.en: Controllable video generation has recently achieved impressive visual quality, yet existing control paradigms remain poorly suited to embodied navigation. Text prompts are spatially ambiguous, while camera-trajectory control relies on low-level motion specifications that are unintuitive for human users and difficult to manipulate. In this work, we introduce Map2Vid, a novel task that reformulates embodied navigation video generation as a BEV-map-to-video synthesis problem, together with a large-scale benchmark for systematic evaluation. By using BEV maps, which provide a visual representation of global scene layout and intended navigation routes, Map2Vid enables human-friendly navigation video generation. To support this task, we construct a dedicated dataset with over 100K navigation sequences across 61 indoor scenes, each paired with egocentric videos, BEV maps, camera trajectories and language instructions. We further develop a unified framework that integrates multiple control signals, together with a curriculum training strategy that progressively weakens non-map inputs, enabling flexible inference under both full conditioning and map-only input. Extensive experiments across multiple foundation generation models demonstrate that controllable navigation video generation via BEV map is a viable and promising direction.
paragraphs.zh: 可控视频生成近来已达到令人瞩目的视觉质量，然而现有的控制范式仍难以很好地适配具身导航任务。 文本提示在空间上是模糊的，而相机轨迹控制则依赖低层级的运动描述，这种方式对人类用户不直观且难以操作。 在本工作中，我们提出了 Map2Vid，这是一个将具身导航视频生成重新表述为 BEV 地图到视频合成问题的新任务，并配套了一个用于系统化评估的大规模基准。 通过使用 BEV 地图——它以可视化方式呈现全局场景布局与预定导航路线——Map2Vid 实现了对人类友好的导航视频生成。 为支持该任务，我们构建了一个专门的数据集，包含跨越 61 个室内场景的超过 10 万条导航序列，每条序列均配有自我中心视频、BEV 地图、相机轨迹和语言指令。 我们进一步开发了一个融合多种控制信号的统一框架，并采用一种逐步削弱非地图输入的课程训练策略，从而在完整条件输入和仅地图输入两种情况下都能实现灵活的推理。 在多个基础生成模型上的大量实验表明，基于 BEV 地图的可控导航视频生成是一个可行且有前景的方向。

paragraphs.en: Embodied navigation [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] requires an agent to perceive the world from an egocentric perspective and move through an environment under the geometric constraints imposed by scene layout. Beyond its importance to Embodied AI, this setting also exposes a distinctive challenge for controllable video generation: the synthesized video must remain temporally coherent [ 4 ] under long-horizon ego-motion, while preserving scene geometry across turns, corridor traversals, and room transitions. Compared with generic text-to-video generation, navigation video synthesis therefore demands stronger spatial grounding, more reliable temporal consistency, and a control interface that can specify motion in an interpretable way.

paragraphs.en: Recent progress in large-scale video generation has substantially improved visual quality and motion realism. Most state-of-the-art approaches [ 5 , 6 ] condition the generation on text prompts and an initial frame, where textual descriptions primarily emphasize the appearance of the scene and cannot provide spatial grounding. This makes it difficult to maintain trajectory consistency and geometric plausibility over long horizons. Several recent works [ 7 , 8 ] attempt to address this limitation by introducing explicit camera trajectory control. Although effective in certain scenarios, they still suffer from two fundamental limitations: First, they support only local, small-scale camera motions (modest translations and rotations). In contrast, embodied navigation involves large-scale cumulative pose changes, including frequent large-angle turns and long-range transitions across rooms, resulting in a substantial mismatch in motion scale. Second, trajectory-based control depends on low-level specifications such as camera transformation matrices. Such representations offer limited abstraction over the spatial structure of the environment, and are fundamentally misaligned with how humans naturally express navigation intent, making them difficult for non-expert use.
paragraphs.zh: 近期大规模视频生成的进展显著提升了视觉质量和运动真实感。 大多数最先进的方法 [ 5 , 6 ] 以文本提示和初始帧为条件进行生成，其中文本描述主要强调场景的外观，无法提供空间定位。 这使得在长时间跨度内保持轨迹一致性和几何合理性变得困难。 近期的几项工作 [ 7 , 8 ] 尝试通过引入显式的相机轨迹控制来解决这一局限。 尽管在某些场景下有效，它们仍然存在两个根本性局限：首先，它们仅支持局部、小尺度的相机运动（小幅平移和旋转）。 相比之下，具身导航涉及大尺度的累积位姿变化，包括频繁的大角度转向和跨房间的长距离移动，导致运动尺度上的严重不匹配。 其次，基于轨迹的控制依赖于相机变换矩阵等底层规范。 这类表示对环境空间结构的抽象能力有限，并且与人类自然表达导航意图的方式根本不一致，使其难以被非专业用户使用。

paragraphs.en: These limitations motivate us to revisit the control signal itself. In natural navigation, humans rarely reason in terms of camera matrices; instead, they reason about the scene layout and the route through it .For this reason, we introduce Map2Vid , a new task that reformulates embodied navigation video generation as a BEV map. As shown in Fig. , Map2Vid takes as input a BEV map depicting the scene layout together with an intended navigation route, and aims to generate an egocentric video consistent with the specified path. Compared to text prompt or camera trajectory, BEV map provides structurally grounded and globally consistent control signals, enabling a more human-friendly control interface for navigation video generation. To instantiate this task, we construct a large-scale dataset Map2Vid-100K . Specifically, we leverage high-fidelity indoor environments of Matterport3D [ 9 ] , and sample valid navigation trajectories from the R2R benchmark [ 2 ] . Each navigation episode is executed in the Habitat-Sim [ 10 ] simulator, during which we record the corresponding egocentric video together with aligned natural language instruction, camera trajectories and BEV map. The dataset covers 61 indoor scenes and contains 117.8K navigation sequences, with 94.2K used for training and 23.6K reserved for evaluation. While our benchmark is constructed in simulation, it provides precise geometric alignment across modalities, which is difficult to obtain in real-world settings.
paragraphs.zh: 这些局限性促使我们重新审视控制信号本身。 在自然导航中，人类很少以相机矩阵的方式进行推理；相反，他们推理的是场景布局以及穿过场景的路线。因此，我们提出了 Map2Vid，一项将具身导航视频生成重新表述为 BEV 地图的新任务。 如图所示，Map2Vid 以描绘场景布局的 BEV 地图以及预定导航路线作为输入，旨在生成与指定路径一致的第一人称视角视频。 与文本提示或相机轨迹相比，BEV 地图提供了在结构上有据可依且全局一致的控制信号，为导航视频生成提供了更符合人类习惯的控制界面。 为了实例化这一任务，我们构建了一个大规模数据集 Map2Vid-100K。 具体而言，我们利用 Matterport3D [9] 的高保真室内环境，并从 R2R 基准 [2] 中采样有效的导航轨迹。 每个导航片段都在 Habitat-Sim [10] 模拟器中执行，在此过程中我们记录相应的第一人称视角视频，以及对其齐的自然语言指令、相机轨迹和 BEV 地图。 该数据集覆盖 61 个室内场景，包含 117.8K 条导航序列，其中 94.2K 条用于训练，23.6K 条保留用于评估。 虽然我们的基准是在模拟环境中构建的，但它提供了各模态之间精确的几何对齐，而这在真实世界场景中是难以获得的。

paragraphs.en: Building on this dataset, we adapt several representative video generation models to support map-conditioned navigation video synthesis. During training, models are provided with multiple control signals, including the BEV map, camera trajectories, text instruction, and initial frame. To prevent models from over-relying on expressive but less human-friendly controls, we propose a curriculum training strategy that gradually weakens non-map conditions, encouraging the model to internalize the spatial dynamics semantics encoded in the BEV map. This design enables flexible inference at test time, supporting either full control signals or the BEV map alone. Extensive experiments demonstrate that controllable navigation video generation via BEV map is viable and promising, while also highlighting the intrinsic difficulty of the task.
paragraphs.zh: 在该数据集的基础上，我们对多个具有代表性的视频生成模型进行适配，使其支持以地图为条件的导航视频合成。 在训练过程中，模型会获得多种控制信号，包括鸟瞰图（BEV）地图、相机轨迹、文本指令以及初始帧。 为防止模型过度依赖表现力强但对人类不够友好的控制信号，我们提出了一种课程式训练策略，逐步弱化非地图条件，促使模型内化鸟瞰图地图中所编码的空间动态语义。 这一设计使模型在测试时能够灵活推理，既支持完整的控制信号，也支持仅使用鸟瞰图地图。 大量实验表明，通过鸟瞰图地图实现可控的导航视频生成是可行且有前景的，同时也凸显了该任务本身的难度。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: (1) We introduce Map2Vid, a novel task that reformulates embodied navigation video generation as a BEV map, providing a human-friendly control interface. (2) We construct Map2Vid-100K, a large-scale benchmark comprising over 117K synchronized multimodal navigation sequences (videos, BEV maps, trajectories, instructions) across 61 scenes, establishing a standardized dataset and dual-aspect evaluation protocol for this new task. (3) We provide a systematic empirical study across four state-of-the-art video foundation models and propose a unified baseline framework with a progressive curriculum training strategy, validating the feasibility of the task and laying a strong empirical foundation for future research.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的贡献有三点：(1) 我们提出 Map2Vid，这是一项新颖的任务，将具身导航视频生成重新表述为基于 BEV 地图的生成问题，提供了对人类友好的控制接口。 (2) 我们构建了 Map2Vid-100K，这是一个大规模基准数据集，包含跨越 61 个场景的超过 117K 条同步的多模态导航序列（视频、BEV 地图、轨迹、指令），为这项新任务建立了一个标准化数据集和双维度评估协议。 (3) 我们对四个最先进的视频基础模型进行了系统的实证研究，并提出了一个采用渐进式课程训练策略的统一基线框架，验证了该任务的可行性，为未来研究奠定了坚实的实证基础。

paragraphs.en: Controllable Video Generation. Recent advances in video generation have been significantly driven by scalable Diffusion Transformers (DiT) [ 11 ] . Prominent examples of this architecture include flagship models such as HunyuanVideo [ 6 , 12 ] and Wan [ 5 ] . Despite these successes, achieving fine-grained controllability in video generation remains challenging. Early approaches adapted image-based conditioning techniques, such as ControlNet [ 13 ] and T2I-Adapter [ 14 ] , to the temporal dimension for structural guidance [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] . While these methods effectively enforce spatial structures (e.g., Canny edges, depth maps, or pose skeletons), they often struggle to maintain long-horizon temporal coherence and 3D geometric consistency. To better control motion dynamics, subsequent works (e.g., MotionCtrl [ 18 ] , DragNUWA [ 19 ] and CameraCtrl [ 7 ] ) introduce explicit camera trajectory-based motion conditioning, with CameraCtrl [ 7 ] standing out with its Plucker embeddings. Though these methods enable the geometry control of the video generation, the input form of accurate camera trajectories is too non-trivial for normal users. By contrast, in this paper, we for the first time introduce and explore the BEV map as a geometric condition.
paragraphs.zh: 可控视频生成。 近期视频生成的进展在很大程度上得益于可扩展的扩散Transformer（Diffusion Transformers, DiT）[11]。 这一架构的典型代表包括HunyuanVideo [6, 12]和Wan [5]等旗舰模型。 尽管取得了这些成功，在视频生成中实现细粒度的可控性仍然具有挑战性。 早期的方法将基于图像的条件控制技术（如ControlNet [13]和T2I-Adapter [14]）适配到时间维度以提供结构引导[15, 16, 17]。 虽然这些方法能够有效施加空间结构（例如Canny边缘、深度图或姿态骨架），但它们往往难以保持长时程的时间一致性和3D几何一致性。 为了更好地控制运动动态，后续工作（如MotionCtrl [18]、DragNUWA [19]和CameraCtrl [7]）引入了基于显式相机轨迹的运动条件控制，其中CameraCtrl [7]凭借其Plücker嵌入而脱颖而出。 尽管这些方法实现了对视频生成的几何控制，但精确相机轨迹这种输入形式对普通用户来说过于复杂。 相比之下，本文首次引入并探索了BEV地图作为几何条件。

paragraphs.en: Embodied Video Understanding & Synthesis. Advanced by large-scale egocentric datasets such as Ego4D [ 20 ] and Ego-Exo4D [ 21 ] , the field has expanded from passive video understanding to agent-centric embodied world models (e.g., GAIA-1 [ 22 ] , UniSim [ 23 ] ). In the realm of embodied video synthesis, existing works primarily address geometric consistency through trajectory conditioning in structured driving domains [ 24 , 25 ] or via cross-view synthesis from third-person observations [ 26 ] . Distinct from these approaches, the potential of top-down BEV maps as a spatially grounded control signal remains largely underexplored. Embodied AI has increasingly shifted from passive perception toward agent-centric understanding, supported by large-scale egocentric datasets such as Ego4D [ 20 ] and Ego-Exo4D [ 21 ] . Beyond understanding, recent work has explored video generation as a foundation for embodied world models that simulate agent–environment interactions, exemplified by GAIA-1 [ 22 ] and UniSim [ 23 ] . A central challenge in this line of research is generating egocentric video that remains consistent with agent motion and scene geometry over long horizons. Several studies address this challenge through trajectory-conditioned generation, particularly in structured domains such as autonomous driving, where motion patterns and scene layouts are relatively constrained (e.g., DriveDreamer [ 25 ] , MagicDrive [ 24 ] ). Other works focus on alleviating the scarcity of egocentric data by synthesizing egocentric views from third-person observations (Exo2Ego), using multi-view and diffusion-based frameworks [ 26 ] .

paragraphs.en: ① Scene Curation and Trajectory Generation: The R2R benchmark provides a large collection of language-guided navigation trajectories grounded in Matterport3D [ 9 ] environments, making it well suited for embodied navigation data construction. Specifically, we employ the Habitat simulator to re-simulate the training split of the R2R dataset, preserving the original navigation instructions and action sequences. To support our scene-by-scene fine-tuning setting, we treat different floors within the same scan as independent scenes and discard trajectories involving cross-floor transitions, ensuring single-level geometric consistency. Within each curated scene, an agent executes the ground-truth actions to generate navigation episodes.
paragraphs.zh: ① 场景筛选与轨迹生成：R2R 基准提供了大量以 Matterport3D [9] 环境为基础、由语言引导的导航轨迹，因此非常适合用于具身导航数据的构建。 具体而言，我们使用 Habitat 模拟器对 R2R 数据集的训练集进行重新仿真，并保留原始的导航指令和动作序列。 为了支持我们逐场景微调的设置，我们将同一扫描中的不同楼层视为独立场景，并丢弃涉及跨楼层移动的轨迹，以确保单层几何一致性。 在每个筛选后的场景中，智能体执行真值动作以生成导航片段。

paragraphs.en: Plücker Embedding for Camera Trajectory. Directly concatenating raw camera matrices (extrinsics and intrinsics) to visual features is suboptimal due to the high dimensionality and non-spatial nature of the parameters. Inspired by CameraCtrl [ 7 ] , we leverage Plücker coordinates to explicitly model the ray geometry of the camera sensor. Concretely, for each step t t in 𝝉 = { 𝐩 t } t = 1 T \boldsymbol{\tau}=\{\mathbf{p}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} , the camera parameters 𝐩 t ∈ ℝ 16 \mathbf{p}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{16} are mapped to a 6-channel Plücker embedding map 𝐄 Plücker ∈ ℝ T × 6 × H × W \mathbf{E}_{\text{Pl\"{u}cker}}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times 6\times H\times W} . paragraphs.en: Temporal Broadcasting: The static map image 𝐦 \mathbf{m} is replicated T T times to match the video length, forming a pseudo-map video sequence 𝐦 s ​ e ​ q ∈ ℝ T × 3 × H × W \mathbf{m}_{seq}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times 3\times H\times W} .

paragraphs.en: Given the inherent bias of standard video models towards text prompts, a naive training strategy often leads to the model neglecting geometric conditions (e.g., generating a generic ”kitchen” while disregarding the specific navigation path). paragraphs.en: All vs. BEV Map-only Conditioning. Inference with the full set of control signals consistently outperforms that relies solely on the BEV map across all backbones and metrics. This indicates that auxiliary conditions play a crucial role in stabilizing generation and improving both visual quality and temporal coherence. At the same time, it highlights the inherent difficulty of the Map2Vid task when rich semantic guidance and explicit low-level motion cues (camera trajectories) are absent. Notably, Wan exhibits the smallest performance drop among all backbones, with especially pronounced advantages on motion-related metrics (e.g., SfM-SR). A plausible explanation is Wan2.2-Camera’s trajectory-based pretraining, which equips it with stronger motion and geometric priors and thus enables it to better leverage the control signals from the BEV map.

paragraphs.en: Inference with Different Control Signals. Following the same experimental setup as in Sec. V-B , Tab. II evaluates the effects of different combinations of control signals during the inference stage. Several observations emerge from the results: ① Full conditioning achieves the best performance on five out of six metrics, including both distributional visual metrics and all three geometric metrics, while yielding a slightly higher LPIPS than some reduced-condition configurations, indicating that semantic cues (instruction and first frame) and geometric cues (BEV map and trajectory) are heterogeneous geometric cues. ② Adding the BEV map and camera trajectory improves motion-related metrics. The BEV map is a stronger standalone control signal than the trajectory, suggesting that it provides richer and more stable global spatial constraints, whereas trajectory-only conditioning lacks sufficient context and is prone to geometric drift. ③ Semantic cues are critical for perceptual quality. Removing the instruction and first frame leads to a pronounced degradation in perceptual metrics, highlighting their role as strong anchors for appearance and semantic consistency.

paragraphs.en: Model Architecture & Training Strategy. To isolate the effect of the training strategy, we conduct ablations on a single representative scene. For evaluation, 60 videos are generated for each setting. We consider the following variant training strategy: (1) w/o Fusion : BEV map and trajectory features are processed independently without 3D convolution; (2) w/o Aggressive Masking : text masking follows r ⁡ ( s ) r(s) instead of r ​ ( s ) 0.5 r(s)^{0.5} ; (3) Constant Masking : masking probabilities are fixed ( 0.9 0.9 for auxiliary conditions and 0.1 0.1 for the BEV map). (4) w/o Warmup : warmup and cooldown phases are removed. As shown in Fig. 4 , we have several insights: ① Removing feature fusion (w/o Fusion) leads to a pronounced performance drop, particularly on motion metrics, indicating that jointly encoding the BEV map and camera trajectory is critical for capturing their strong geometric coupling. ② Variants with constant masking or without warmup consistently underperform, highlighting the importance of a smooth, progressive masking schedule for reducing reliance on auxiliary conditions. ③ w/o Aggressive Masking variant confirms that aggressively suppressing textual cues helps prevent shortcut learning, this suggests that more principled training strategies could be a promising direction for future work.

paragraphs.en: Robust Geometric Control. Despite the substantial decline in visual fidelity, the degradation in geometric metrics representing camera trajectory motion (SFM-SR, APE trans \text{APE}_{\text{trans}} , and APE rot \text{APE}_{\text{rot}} ) is remarkably less pronounced. Even in the highly challenging Sim2Real setting—which combines completely hand-drawn BEV maps with a massive real-world domain gap—the model maintains considerable 3D structural integrity and trajectory alignment. This stark contrast between visual and geometric performance degradation strongly indicates that the model has not merely overfitted to the visual textures of the training scenes, but has genuinely learned the generalized ability to control long-horizon camera motion directly from the BEV map conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 鲁棒的几何控制。 尽管视觉保真度大幅下降，但代表相机轨迹运动的几何指标（SFM-SR、平移 APE \text{APE}_{\text{trans}} 与旋转 APE \text{APE}_{\text{rot}}）的退化程度却明显轻得多。 即使在极具挑战性的 Sim2Real 设定下——即完全手绘的 BEV 地图与巨大的真实世界域差相结合——模型仍保持相当程度的 3D 结构完整性与轨迹对齐。 视觉性能与几何性能退化之间的这种鲜明对比有力地表明，模型并非仅仅过拟合于训练场景的视觉纹理，而是真正学会了直接从 BEV 地图条件出发控制长时程相机运动的泛化能力。

sents.en: Despite the substantial decline in visual fidelity, the degradation in geometric metrics representing camera trajectory motion (SFM-SR, APE trans \text{APE}_{\text{trans}} , and APE rot \text{APE}_{\text{rot}} ) is remarkably less pronounced.
sents.zh: 尽管视觉保真度大幅下降，但代表相机轨迹运动的几何指标（SFM-SR、平移 APE \text{APE}_{\text{trans}} 与旋转 APE \text{APE}_{\text{rot}}）的退化程度却明显轻得多。

sents.en: Even in the highly challenging Sim2Real setting—which combines completely hand-drawn BEV maps with a massive real-world domain gap—the model maintains considerable 3D structural integrity and trajectory alignment.
sents.zh: 即使在极具挑战性的 Sim2Real 设定下——即完全手绘的 BEV 地图与巨大的真实世界域差相结合——模型仍保持相当程度的 3D 结构完整性与轨迹对齐。

sents.en: This stark contrast between visual and geometric performance degradation strongly indicates that the model has not merely overfitted to the visual textures of the training scenes, but has genuinely learned the generalized ability to control long-horizon camera motion directly from the BEV map conditions.

paragraphs.en: Beyond controllable video generation, Map2Vid has the potential to support vision-and-language navigation (VLN) by providing visual imagination of candidate navigation routes. Specifically, the generated egocentric videos allow navigation agents to anticipate visual observations along different routes before execution, potentially facilitating more informed route selection. To explore this potential utility, we conduct a proof-of-concept experiment in which a VLM selects the most instruction-consistent route based on generated videos.
paragraphs.zh: 除了可控视频生成之外，Map2Vid 还有潜力支持视觉-语言导航（VLN），为候选导航路线提供视觉想象。 具体而言，生成的以自我为中心的视频使导航智能体能够在执行之前预判不同路线上的视觉观察，从而有望促成更明智的路线选择。 为探索这一潜在用途，我们进行了一项概念验证实验，让一个视觉语言模型（VLM）基于生成的视频选出与指令最一致的路线。

paragraphs.en: For each navigation instruction, we construct three candidate BEV routes, including the ground-truth route and two perturbed routes with incorrect turns or shifted endpoints. Map2Vid generates an egocentric video for each candidate, and the VLM selects the video that best matches the instruction. We evaluate 10 such instances, each containing three candidate videos. As shown in Tab. V , the evaluated VLMs achieve top-1 accuracies of 50.0%, 70.0%, and 60.0%, respectively, exceeding the random baseline of 33.3%. Although preliminary, these results demonstrate the feasibility of leveraging Map2Vid-generated videos as visual evidence for candidate-route selection, highlighting their potential to assist downstream VLN decision-making. Beyond route selection, the generated videos could also support future observation prediction, look-ahead navigation planning, and synthetic data augmentation for navigation policy learning. We leave the systematic integration of Map2Vid into VLN agents and the evaluation of its impact on downstream navigation performance to future work.

paragraphs.en: Qualitative results. Fig. 5 shows qualitative results generated by Wan2.2-Camera. Overall, both full-conditioning and map-only inference produce long-horizon navigation videos with substantial egocentric motion while maintaining reasonable per-frame visual quality, without obvious artifacts such as excessive blur, temporal flickering, or physically implausible distortions. Without semantic guidance from the reference frame and language instruction, map-only generations often start from an appearance that deviates from the ground-truth, but this discrepancy tends to diminish as the video progresses. In terms of path following, both settings recover the overall trend of camera motion, though fine-grained motion remains challenging, with errors such as under- or over-rotation at turning points and temporal drift in translation. paragraphs.en: Trajectory Following Visualization. To further assess the geometric controllability of Map2Vid, we visualize the camera trajectories reconstructed from generated videos and compare them with the corresponding ground-truth navigation routes on BEV maps. Specifically, we employ VGGSfM to recover the camera motion from generated egocentric videos and align the reconstructed trajectories with the reference coordinate system. As illustrated in Fig. 6 , the recovered trajectory in this example closely follows the specified navigation route, preserving its overall motion pattern and turning structure. This qualitative observation complements the trajectory accuracy metrics and provides additional evidence that BEV maps can guide egocentric video generation along designated navigation routes.

paragraphs.en: While Map2Vid establishes a robust baseline for map-conditioned navigation video generation, several limitations warrant further investigation. Our study is conducted in a controlled simulated setting. The current benchmark is built by replaying R2R trajectories in Habitat over Matterport3D scenes, which enables precise synchronization between routed BEV maps, egocentric videos, language instructions, and camera trajectories. This design is important for task formulation and reproducible evaluation, but it also means that our conclusions are limited to a simulation-based benchmark rather than real-world deployment. In particular, appearance statistics, rendering artifacts, and motion dynamics in simulation may differ from those encountered by physical embodied agents. A natural next step is therefore to extend Map2Vid toward real-world or mixed-reality data sources, and to study whether BEV-based control remains effective under stronger domain variability.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 Map2Vid 为地图条件下的导航视频生成建立了一个稳健的基线，但仍存在若干值得进一步研究的局限性。 我们的研究是在受控的仿真环境中进行的。 当前的基准是通过在 Habitat 中于 Matterport3D 场景上重放 R2R 轨迹构建的，这使得路由 BEV 地图、自我中心视频、语言指令和相机轨迹之间能够实现精确同步。 这一设计对于任务构建和可复现的评估非常重要，但也意味着我们的结论仅限于基于仿真的基准，而非真实世界的部署。 特别是，仿真中的外观统计特性、渲染伪影和运动动态可能与物理具身智能体所遇到的情况不同。 因此，一个自然的下一步是将 Map2Vid 扩展到真实世界或混合现实数据源，并研究基于 BEV 的控制在更强的领域变化下是否仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, while the framework effectively captures global navigation intent, fine-grained motion execution, such as precise angular orientation at sharp turns or subtle translational stability, remains a challenge, as evidenced by occasional errors in trajectory adherence observed in our qualitative analysis. Another constraint lies in the static nature of the current dataset: our formulation primarily focuses on fixed indoor layouts and does not yet account for dynamic obstacles or human-agent interactions, which are critical for comprehensive embodied intelligence. Finally, the reliance on large-scale Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) such as Wan2.2 and HunyuanVideo involves substantial computational overhead and inference latency, suggesting that future research into model distillation or efficient temporal attention mechanisms is necessary. paragraphs.en: In this work, we present Map2Vid , a novel framework that addresses the limitations of existing video generation models in providing intuitive and spatially grounded control for embodied navigation. By introducing Bird’s-Eye-View (BEV) maps as a human-friendly geometric condition, Map2Vid enables the synthesis of coherent egocentric videos that respect global scene layouts. A curriculum training strategy with progressive masking is adopted to regulate condition visibility, preventing shortcut learning and ensuring the model effectively internalizes the spatial dynamics encoded in the BEV maps. Through the construction of the large-scale Map2Vid-100K benchmark, it is found that our method supports flexible inference, achieving robust performance even when conditioned solely on BEV maps without explicit camera trajectories. Experimental results across multiple foundation models demonstrate the effectiveness and promise of the Map2Vid direction.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 Map2Vid，这是一个新颖的框架，旨在解决现有视频生成模型在为具身导航提供直观且具有空间依据的控制方面的局限性。 通过引入鸟瞰图（BEV）地图作为对人类友好的几何条件，Map2Vid 能够合成符合全局场景布局的连贯第一人称视角视频。 我们采用带有渐进式掩码的课程训练策略来调节条件的可见性，防止捷径学习，并确保模型有效内化 BEV 地图中所编码的空间动态。 通过构建大规模的 Map2Vid-100K 基准，我们发现本方法支持灵活的推理，即使仅以 BEV 地图为条件而不提供显式的相机轨迹，也能取得稳健的性能。 在多个基础模型上的实验结果证明了 Map2Vid 这一方向的有效性与前景。

paragraphs.en: Modeling navigation across different floors introduces complex vertical transitions and spatial discontinuities, which are notoriously difficult for generative models to synthesize accurately. To ensure data consistency and focus on high-fidelity planar navigation, we strictly exclude trajectories involving cross-floor actions. Specifically, we employ a two-stage filtering mechanism consisting of floor segmentation and trajectory verification.
paragraphs.zh: 对跨楼层的导航进行建模会引入复杂的垂直过渡和空间不连续性，这对于生成式模型而言是众所周知的难以精确合成的难题。 为确保数据一致性并聚焦于高保真的平面导航，我们严格排除了涉及跨楼层动作的轨迹。 具体而言，我们采用由楼层分割和轨迹验证组成的两阶段过滤机制。

paragraphs.en: Floor Segmentation. We first initialize a floor detector that performs a bottom-up vertical scanning of the entire 3D scene. By analyzing the projected top-down views of the navigation mesh at varying altitudes, the detector computes pixel similarity scores between adjacent vertical slices. Significant deviations in similarity allow us to identify floor boundaries, thereby defining precise height intervals (coordinates along the Y Y -axis) for each distinct floor.
paragraphs.zh: 地面分割。 我们首先初始化一个地面检测器，对整个三维场景执行自底向上的垂直扫描。 通过分析导航网格在不同高度下的俯视投影图，该检测器计算相邻垂直切片之间的像素相似度分数。 相似度的显著偏差使我们能够识别地面边界，从而为每个不同的楼层定义精确的高度区间（沿 Y Y 轴的坐标）。

We specifically focus on the Full Control setting (incorporating BEV Map, Camera Trajectory, Text Instruction, and First Frame), analyzing how the synergy between semantic and geometric streams shapes the generation process compared to single-modality baselines.

paragraphs.en: The quantitative superiority of the Full Control setting, particularly in perceptual metrics (FID, FVD), can be attributed to its ability to simultaneously constrain two manifolds in the latent space:
paragraphs.zh: 完全控制（Full Control）设置在数量上的优势，尤其是在感知指标（FID、FVD）上的优势，可以归因于它能够同时约束潜在空间中的两个流形：

paragraphs.en: Appearance Anchoring. In the map-only setting, the model is tasked with hallucinating 3D textures solely from a schematic layout. While the BEV map effectively dictates the structural topology (e.g., wall placements, room connections), it remains texturally ambiguous. This ambiguity forces the generative backbone to sample from a high-entropy distribution of possible appearances, often leading to temporal flickering and inconsistent texturing as the video progresses. The Full Control setting mitigates this by utilizing the First Frame and Text Instruction as strong semantic anchors. These inputs lock the generation into a specific subspace of the appearance manifold, resolving textural ambiguity. Consequently, the model can dedicate its geometric capacity—derived from the BEV map—to motion synthesis rather than texture hallucination.
paragraphs.zh: 外观锚定。 在仅地图的设定中，模型需要仅凭示意图布局来生成三维纹理。 尽管鸟瞰图（BEV）地图有效规定了结构拓扑（如墙体位置、房间连接），但它在纹理上仍存在歧义。 这种歧义迫使生成主干从可能外观的高熵分布中采样，随着视频推进，往往导致时序闪烁和纹理不一致。 完整控制设定通过利用首帧和文本指令作为强语义锚点来缓解这一问题。 这些输入将生成锁定到外观流形的特定子空间中，消除了纹理歧义。 因此，模型能够将来自鸟瞰图地图的几何容量用于运动合成，而非纹理生成。

paragraphs.en: Geometric Grounding. Conversely, relying exclusively on semantic cues (common in standard T2V models) often results in “plausible but incorrect” navigation, where agents may traverse obstacles or violate spatial continuity. By integrating the BEV map and camera trajectory within the Full Control stack, we impose strict boundary conditions on the agent’s action space. Thus, Full Control does not merely provide more information; it creates a complementary constraint system where semantic priors ensure visual fidelity while geometric priors enforce physical plausibility.
paragraphs.zh: 几何接地。 相反，仅依赖语义线索（这在标准 T2V 模型中很常见）往往会导致「看似合理但不正确」的导航，智能体可能会穿越障碍物或违反空间连续性。 通过将 BEV 地图和相机轨迹整合到 Full Control 堆栈中，我们对智能体的动作空间施加了严格的边界条件。 因此，Full Control 不仅仅是提供更多信息；它构建了一个互补的约束系统，其中语义先验确保视觉保真度，而几何先验则保证物理合理性。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Fig. 7 8 , the results under the Map-only setting are particularly noteworthy. Despite lacking explicit camera pose matrices or starting visual context, the model successfully synthesizes navigation videos that are semantically coherent. While the Full Control outputs (middle rows) naturally achieve higher fidelity in texture details due to the sexampltrong guidance from the first frame and trajectory, the Map-only outputs (bottom rows) correctly reflect the scene geometry, room transitions, and navigational intent. This qualitative evidence strongly supports the viability of Map2Vid, confirming that BEV maps provide adequate spatial grounding to guide the generation of long-horizon embodied navigation videos without the need for unintuitive low-level trajectory specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 7 8 所示，在 Map-only 设置下的结果尤其值得关注。 尽管缺少显式的相机位姿矩阵或起始视觉上下文，模型仍成功合成了语义连贯的导航视频。 虽然 Full Control 的输出（中间几行）由于受到第一帧和轨迹的强引导，自然在纹理细节上达到更高的保真度，但 Map-only 的输出（底部几行）正确地反映了场景几何、房间过渡以及导航意图。 这一 qualitative 证据有力地支持了 Map2Vid 的可行性，确认 BEV 地图能够提供充分的空间锚定，以引导长时程具身导航视频的生成，而无需不直观的低层轨迹规格。

paragraphs.en: Although Full Control provides richer conditioning signals, our ablation study reveals a potential optimization challenge: Modality Competency Collapse .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管完全控制（Full Control）提供了更丰富的条件信号，但我们的消融研究揭示了一个潜在的优化挑战：模态能力坍缩（Modality Competency Collapse）。

paragraphs.en: DiT backbones pre-trained on large-scale video data tend to favor familiar text and image conditions. Under naive training (e.g., Constant Masking), the model may over-rely on these semantic cues while underutilizing the novel BEV signal, producing visually plausible videos with inaccurate navigation paths.
paragraphs.zh: 在大规模视频数据上预训练的 DiT 骨干网络往往偏向熟悉的文本和图像条件。 在朴素训练（例如恒定掩码）下，模型可能过度依赖这些语义线索，而未能充分利用新颖的 BEV 信号，从而生成视觉上合理但导航路径不准确的视频。

sents.en: Under naive training (e.g., Constant Masking), the model may over-rely on these semantic cues while underutilizing the novel BEV signal, producing visually plausible videos with inaccurate navigation paths.

paragraphs.en: Our curriculum masking strategy mitigates this issue by temporarily suppressing dominant semantic conditions, encouraging the model to learn BEV-based geometric constraints before integrating all modalities. This facilitates more effective multimodal conditioning and improves navigation consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的课程掩码策略通过暂时抑制占主导地位的语义条件来缓解这一问题，促使模型在整合所有模态之前先学习基于 BEV 的几何约束。 这有助于实现更有效的多模态条件控制，并提升导航的一致性。
